title: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals
tagline: Demonstrate fundamental AI concepts related to the development of software and services of Microsoft Azure to create AI solutions.
overview: Certifications As a candidate for this Microsoft Certification, you’re at the beginning of your career in AI solution development. For this exam, you should have conceptual knowledge of AI solutions in Azure and the foundational technical skills to work with them. You also need knowledge of Python coding syntax and programming techniques, and you should be familiar with Azure resources.
